description: The file defines an immutable implementation of the Features interface, providing methods to manage features within a JSON-based model related to 'things'. It includes data structures, factory methods, and serialization logic specific to features in the Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatures
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Features interface, supporting feature management within a JSON-backed model.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates a new empty ImmutableFeatures instance.

methods.name: of (Iterable<Feature>)
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableFeatures instance initialized with provided features.

methods.name: of (Feature, Feature...)
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableFeatures instance initialized with specified features.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the feature for the given ID.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Returns a new Features instance with the specified feature inserted or replaced.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Returns a new Features instance with the feature of the specified ID removed.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets a feature's definition, returning a new Features instance.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes the feature's definition, returning a new Features instance.

methods.name: setProperties
methods.description: Sets properties of a feature, returning a new Features instance.

methods.name: removeProperties
methods.description: Removes properties from a feature, returning a new Features instance.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a specific property for a feature, returning a new Features instance.

methods.name: removeProperty
methods.description: Removes a specific property from a feature, returning a new Features instance.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no features.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the features to a JsonObject, considering schema version and predicate.
